name: of1-demo-skills
description: Turn any website into an OF1 generative-search demo on Adobe Edge Delivery Services (replica-based Stage 2). Ships the runtime-agnostic orchestrator, discovery, and a standalone signals.json authoring skill. Depends on of1-skills for the OF1-integration step.

_notes.entrypoints: of1-demo-orchestrator is the single runtime-agnostic orchestrator — it detects Claude Code vs SLICC at start and follows knowledge/dispatch-cc.md or knowledge/dispatch-slicc.md accordingly. Stage 3 (OF1 integration) dispatches the of1-skills plugin's skills directly — see of1-skills's of1-integration/SKILL.md for that step graph. of1-signals is a standalone skill, not a numbered pipeline step — it authors extension-only config (signals.json) that neither the sync/deploy pipeline nor the OF1 worker ever reads.
